name: search_dev_beam_8192
notes: Development-scale beam search (8192 unique predictions, the plan §4.1 starting budget; beam 32 x 32 offspring with 80/20 one/two-hop mix, 10% global restart, diversity distance 2 over the top 4x beam pool). Engineering throughput test on the server (nohup, check load, 4-8 workers); on Windows the local xgboost fallback backend is recorded in model_id and must not be compared to server numbers as the same backend.
